transformations: Renamed five column headers for R use.
Preserved all 33 source rows, product labels and numerical values in source order.
No filtering, imputation, currency conversion or inflation adjustment.
verification: Reopened CSV and compared every product label and numerical value against the source worksheet.
book_reference: Berenson, Levine and Krehbiel, Basic Business Statistics: Concepts and Applications, ninth edition, exercise 3.68, pp. 127–128.
